newsitem.title: USA: Honeywell unit wins $100 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Honeywell unit wins $100 mln contract.

text.p: Honeywell Inc said on Wednesday its Honeywell Space Systems unit was awarded spacecraft contracts worth about $100 million from the U.S. Air Force.

The company said it would design, develop and provide the on-board spacecraft and payload processors for five geosynchronous spacecraft for the high component of the U.S. Air Force's space-based infrared system program.
Honeywell said it was a member of the Lockheed Martin Corp space-based infrared system team, which was awarded the overall $1.8 billion-plus program on November 8.
